name: Art Gallery of NSW free entry and student concession
provider: Art Gallery of New South Wales
summary: Free general entry to the Art Gallery of NSW, with concession tickets for full-time student card holders at ticketed exhibitions.
key: Entry to the Art Gallery is free and does not require a ticket.
who: Full-time student card holders, for concession tickets to ticketed exhibitions.
how: Bring your card to show at the exhibition entry.
catches: Concession prices are not stated on this page.
The gallery's Inspire membership also has concession pricing for full-time student card holders.
